properties.name: A1825/26 / TDCF
properties.originalText:
HELICOPTER SLING OPS WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE LAUDAT AREA, SOUTHERN
PART OF THE ISLAND, BY HELICOPTER REGISTRATION N133TH BTN BASE
STATION 153256N0611648W AND SUMMIT STATION 153056N0611729W. FLIGHT
PATHS BTN THE OPERATIONAL ZONE AND TDCF MAY BE CONDUCTED UP TO
3000FT AMSL AND WILL
BE COORDINATED WITH ATC. PILOTS ARE ADVISED TO EXER CTN AND MAINTAIN
VIGILANCE FOR HELICOPTER ACTIVITY IN THE VCY.
